sanskrit: devi varṣasahasrāyuḥ śāstrāntaṃ naiva gacchatitasmāt sāraṃ vijānīyāt kṣīraṃ haṃsa ivāmbhasaḥpalālamiva dhānyārthī sarvaśāstraṃ parityajettattvajñasya tathā devi na śāstreṇa prayojanamjñānādeva hi muktiḥ syānnānyathā vīravanditetathaiva sarvaśāstrāṇi jñānameva hi kāraṇamkāṣṭhabhāraśramādasmādekaṃ sañjīvanaṃ paramguruvaktreṇa labhyeta nānyathāgamakoṭibhiḥśabdabrahmāgamamayaṃ paraṃ brahma vivekajammama tattvaṃ ca jānanti dvaitādvaitavivajītammameti bādhyate janturna mameti vimucyateāyāsāyāparaṃ karma vidyānyā śilpanaipuṇamyāvadindriyacāpalyaṃ tāvattattvakathā kutaḥyāvanna manasaḥ sthairyaṃ tāvattattvakathā kutaḥyāvanna gurukāruṇyaṃ tāvattattvakathā kutaḥvedaśāstrāgamakathā yāvattattvaṃ na vindatetattvaniṣṭho bhaveddevi yadīcchenmokṣamātmanaḥtāpatrayāttīsantaptaśchāyāṃ mokṣataroḥ śrayetkuladharmamṛte muktarnāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥsukhena mucyate devi ghorasaṃsārabandhanātsamāsena kuleśāni kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasisthitikathanaṃ nāma prathamollāsaḥkuladharmastvayā deva sūcito na prakāśitaḥvada me parameśāna yadi te'sti kṛpā mayitasya śravaṇamātreṇa yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavet

sanskrit: kathayāmi tava snehāt śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasāakathyaṃ paramārthena tathāpi kathayāmi tedeyaṃ bhaktāya śiṣyāya anyathā patanaṃ bhavetvaiṣṇavāduttamaṃ śaivaṃ śaivāddakṣiṇamuttamamsiddhāntāduttamaṃ kaulaṃ kaulāt parataraṃ na hisākṣāt śivapradaṃ devi karṇākaṇīgataṃ kulamsārajñena mayā devi kuladharmaḥ samuddhṛtaḥekataḥ kuladharmaśca tatra kaulo'dhikaḥ priyetathaiva vividhā dharmāḥ praviṣṭāḥ kulameva hidarśanāni ca sarvāṇi kula eva tathā priyetadā ca kuladharmeṇa samayo'nyaḥ samo bhavettathaiva samayāḥ sarve kuladharmeṇa no samāḥtathānyasamayasyāpi kulasya mahadantaramkulena samadharmastu tathāpi na kadācanabaddhaḥ saṃsārapāśena so'ntyajānāṃ priyo bhavetbrahmahatyādhikaṃ pāpaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥsvargādi dvīpāntaraṃ gatvā mokṣaratnaṃ samaśnutemokṣaṃ labhante kaule tu sadya eva na saṃśayaḥna kaulasamadharmo'sti tvāṃ śape kulanāyikebhogayogātmakaṃ kaulaṃ tasmāt sarvādhikaṃ priyemokṣāyate ca saṃsāraḥ kuladharme kuleśvarikuladharmaparā devi mānuṣeṣu ca kā kathākulameva vijānīyādyadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥsvapnotthita pratyayavadupadeśādikaṃ vinātāmeva labhate janturupadeśo nirarthakaḥ

sanskrit: mantraivīśuddhacittasya kulajñānaṃ prakāśatekuladharmasthitā ye ca te sarve'pyanivarttakāḥkṣīṇāṃhasāṃ nṛṇāṃ devi kulajñānaṃ prakāśatedevatāgurubhaktyā ca kulajñānaṃ prakāśateatibhaktasya guhyasya kulajñānaṃ prakāśateyasya bhaktirdṛḍhā tasya kulajñānaṃ prakāśategurvājñāpālakairdharmaiḥ kulajñānamavāpyatetasmāt parīkṣya vaktavyaṃ kulajñānaṃ mayoditamājñābhaṅgañca yaḥ kuryāddevatāśāpamāpnuyātsa guruścāpi śiṣyaśca yoginīnāṃ bhavet paśuḥlabhete tāvubhau sākṣādyoginīvīramelanamkuladharmamimaṃ jñātvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥacirānnātra sandehastasmāt kaulaṃ samāśrayetsvagṛhe pāyasaṃ tyaktvā bhikṣāmaṭati pārvatikarasthaṃ ratnamutsṛjya dūrasthaṃ kācamīhatesa dhānyarāśimutsṛjya pāṃsurāśiṃ jighṛkṣatitaḍāgādiva tṛṣṇārtto mṛgatṛṣṇāṃ pradhāvatiśrīkaulādanyasamayāstādṛśāḥ kulanāyikepārāvāramapāraṃ sa pāṇibhyāṃ tarttumicchatisvapnalabdhadhanenaiva dhanavān sa bhavettadātathānyasamayebhyaśca bhuktirmuktiḥ prakāśatekulaniṣṭhaḥ kuleśāni bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanamso'pi sadgatimāpnoti kimutāsya parāyaṇaḥpūjitaḥ pūjayatyāśu tasmāttaṃ na parityajetjanā hasantu māṃ dṛṣṭvā rājāno daṇḍayantu vā

sanskrit: tvaddharma naiva muñcāmi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥsa tu sampūjyate devairamutra sa śivo bhavetyastvāmupāste bhaktyā sa naraḥ sadgatimāpnuyātmṛtiradya yugānte vā kulaṃ naiva parityajetna kāmanna bhayādvāpi kuladharmaṃ parityajetkliśyate jātamātreṇa bhūtāriṇātmaśatruṇābudbudā iva toyeṣu ye kaulavimukhā hi tesa jīvati mano yasya kuladharme vyavasthitamsa lohakārabhasrevaśvasannapi na jīvatikuleśvari kulājñasya tat paśoriva jīvitamvratastho'pyavratastho vā yaḥ kaulavimukho janaḥkuladharmaparā devi śeṣāśca dvāragardabhāḥaparastu paraṃ satyamasthikūṭatvacāvṛtaḥśvapaco'pi kulajñānī brāhmaṇādatiricyatekulapūjārato devi so'yaṃ kaulo na cetareḥna pūjayati dhik tasya tat kākasyeva jīvitamyeṣāṃ bhāgyavaśāddevi kulajñānaṃ prakāśateyeṣāmutpadyate citte kulajñānaṃ mayoditamyat sarvayajñācaraṇaṃ kuladharmapraveśanamte punarjananīgarbha na viśanti kadācanakulajñānasya kuleśāni nānyadharmaiḥ prayojanamdadāmi paramaṃ jñānaṃ cāntakāle na saṃśayaḥsukhena sarvaphaladaṃ kulaṃ ko'pi tyajatyahovedaśāstrāgamajño'pi kulājñastvajña eva hicakorā eva jānanti nānye candragatāṃ rucim

sanskrit: devatāsannidhau bālāmupaveśya samarcayetkadalīnārikelādiphalaistāṃ paritoṣayetyathāśakti japedekottaravṛddhyā'thavā manumtatastāṃ devatābuddhyā namaskṛtya visarjayetevaṃ tithau kumārīñca yajet pūrvadinācītāmsarasvatī ramā gaurī durgā ca nava kīttītāḥnāmabhiśca caturthyantaiḥ pūjayettāḥ pṛthak pṛthakgandhapuṣpāmbarākalpairyathāvibhavavistaraiḥsvakāryaphalasiddhyarthaṃ vittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥnavarātrakṛtāṃ pūjāṃ devi devyai samarpayetevaṃ navakumārīṇāmarcanaṃ prātavatsarammano'bhilāṣaṃ samprāpya nivasettava sannidhaumanojñāḥ pūjayedbhaktyā navarātriṣu mantravitpūrvavat pūrvamadyādyaiḥ padārthaiḥ paritoṣayetsādhakastuṣṭimāsādya nivasettava sannidhauṣaṇmāse vā trimāse vā māse māse'thavā priyesarvaiśvaryasamṛddhātmā sa bhavedāvayoḥ priyaḥsarvalakṣaṇasampannāmanukūlāṃ manoramāmabhyaṅgasnānaśuddhāṅgīmāsane copaveśayetātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṅkuryāt kuleśvarikṛtvā kramārcanaṃ dhūpadīpāñca kuladīpakānmāṃsādibhakṣyabhojyādyaistoṣayeddevi bhaktitaḥyauvanollāsasahitaḥ svayaṃ taddhyānatatparaḥjapādikaṃ samarpyātha tayā saha niśāṃ nayetpūjayedvidhinā'nena tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate

sanskrit: yad yat svamanaso'bhīṣṭaṃ tattadāpnotyasaṃśayamstotraiḥ saṃpūjayet sarvairmahadaiśvaryamāpnuyāttulāyāṃ siṃhameṣe vā sarvasaṃkrāntiṣu priyeśacīndrau rohiṇīcandrau svāhāgnī ca prabhāravīmithunāni navābhyarcya pūrvoktenaiva vartmanāgandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya madyādyaiḥ paritoṣayetanugṛhṇanti taṃ devi prayacchanti manorathamtava loke sa nivaset sarvaiśvaryasamanvitaḥbrāhme muhūrtte utthāya snānaṃ sandhyāmupāsya caātmānaṃ gandhapuṣpādyairalaṅkṛtya vidhānavitkiñcidabhyudite sūrye maṇḍale sveṣṭadevatāmṣoḍaśairupacāraistu cakrapūjāpuraḥsarammatsyamāṃsādi vidhivadbhakṣya bhojyasamanvitamyauvanollāsasahito nivīkāreṇa cetasājaptvā samarpya tatpūjāṃ devatāñca samuddharetkuryājjapārcanaṃ kṛṣṇacaturddaśyantamambiketripañcasapta nava vā vittalobhavivajītaḥdevatā tasya santuṣṭā dadāti phalamīpsitamsa tu tatphalamāpnoti yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavetkāṅkṣitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ devavad vicared bhuvisnātvā śuklāmbaradharaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsya cayauvanollāsasahitaścandrasthāṃ devatāṃ smaranevaṃ pratidinaṃ śuklacaturddaśyantamarcayetevaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā śuklapakṣārcanaṃ priyesarvalokaikasaṃpūjyaḥ śivavannivased bhuvi

sanskrit: yaḥ karoti vidhānena sarvān kāmān samaśnuteyoginīvīramelanaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥsnātvācamya viśuddhātmā nyāsān kṛtvā puroditānpūrvārcanokta vidhinā sarvadravyasamanvitaḥpañcavarṇarajaścitravasupatrasaroruhedīpaṃ saṃsthāpya purata uttarābhimukhasthitaḥyauvanollāsasahito dīpasthāṃ devatāṃ smaranevaṃ samarcayet kṛṣṇacaturddaśyantamambikeevaṃ kṛte kuleśāni devatā prītimāpnuyātsarvalokaikasammānyaḥ sañcaret sa yathāsukhamdvātriṃśaddivaseṣvevaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidineṣu cakramajñaścet svayaṃ kuryādvittaśāṭhyavivajītaḥmaṅgalādyaiśca mithunairaṣṭabhiḥ śabditāḥ priyeakṣobhyādicatuḥṣaṣṭimithunāni samarcayetkramalopaṃ na kurvīta sveṣṭakāryārthasiddhayesamyak santoṣayeddevi mithunānyatibhaktitaḥevaṃ yaḥ kurute devi sakṛdaṣṭāṣṭakārcanamkiṃ punarmānavādyaiśca sākṣāt śiva ivāparaḥpunarāvṛttirahito nivasettava sannidhauasmāt paratarā pūjā nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥyajñadānatapastīrthavratakoṭiphalaṃ labhetcatuḥsāgaraparyantāṃ mahīṃ śāsti na saṃśayaḥpūrvoktena vidhānena kuleśvari vidhānavitprauḍhāntollāsayuktāni mithunāni samarcayettava loke vaseddevi brahmādisurasaṃstutaḥ

sanskrit: tasmāt śrīcakramadhye tu saṃsmaret sarvadevatāḥanugrahantu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathākramamśucidravyasamāyuktaṃ cakrapūjāsamanvitamprapūjayecca varṇasthāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥpāyasājyaudanairyuktairnaivedyairbhaktisaṃyutaiḥhasakha phreṃ hesauṃ(hsauṃ) ḍāṃ ḍīṃ ḍamalavarayūṃ tataḥsaṅkalpya manaso'bhīṣṭaṃ madhuratritayaḥ priyepūjayitvepsitān kāmān prārthayet kamalānaneātmanaśca parasyāpi rakṣārthaṃ pūjayet priyevaśyārthaṃ maṅgalārthañca dharmakarmārthasiddhayeekaviṃśadinānyatra labhate cepsitaṃ phalamkulāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭisamanvitamvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchet siddhimātmanaḥacītavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakaiḥ sveṣṭasiddhayesaṃpūjya saptamīṃ devīṃ pūjayet sarvasiddhayepratigṛhṇayugaṃ svāhā iti nirmālyasarjanamkamaṇḍaluṃ karttṛkāñca dhārayantī varapradākhaḍgakheṭakasaṃyuktā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitāpāṭalīpuṣpasaṅkāśā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitātrimukhīṃ muṇḍasaṃyuktā siddhidā sarvaśobhanākuliśañca tathā daṇḍaṃ dhārayanti śucismitāekadvitricatuḥpañcaṣaṇmukhā sarabhābhayāsamāsena kuleśāni kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasiviśeṣadivasārcanaṃ nāma daśamollāsaḥkulācārakramaṃ deva vada me karuṇānidhe

sanskrit: na bhavet sadgurau bhaktiryāvaddeveśi dehināmguruprasādamūlo'yaṃ paratattvamahākramaḥtathā bhaktyā dhanaiḥ prāṇairguruṃ yatnena toṣayettadā mukto bhavecchiṣyastato nāsti punarbhavaḥgurau prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavetsampādayanti tān sarvān svāmino bhaktavatsalāḥkurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥkarmamukto bhavecchiṣyoḥ bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanampriyaṃ kuryācca deveśi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥmukto'sīti samādiṣṭaḥ so'pi muktiṃ vrajet priyekaroti gururūpeṇa paśupāśavimocanamtasmai deyaṃ tato grāhyaṃ sa tu pūjyo hyahaṃ tathāmleccho'pi guṇahīno'pi bhaktimān śiṣya ucyatesarvaṃ naśyati tatraiva bhūṣaṇaṃ lokarañjanamśvapaco'pi paraiḥ pūjyo vidvānapi na nāstikaḥsarvārthaiḥ śrīgurau devi yasya bhaktiḥ sadā sthirāiti bhaktyā smared yastu tasya sidviradūrataḥtasya te kathitā hyarthāḥ prakāśante kuleśvaribhaktiryathā mahādevi tathā kāryā nije gurauśrīguruṃ gurupatnīñca pitarāviti cintayetyajñaḥ dānatapastīrthavratādyairna tathā priyetathā tathāsya vijñānaṃ varddhate kulanāyikenirvyājasevā deveśi bhaktireṣā hi sadguroḥtat phalaṃ labhate devi sukhena gurusevayābhaktireva gurau devi nānyaḥ panthā iti śrutiḥ

sanskrit: bhaktiḥ kṣaṇena dahati tūlarāśimivānalaḥyena mṛddāruddaṣadaḥ phalantyaviphalaṃ phalamamāye kulamārge'smin bhaktireva viśiṣyatekinnu bhaktimatāṃ kṣetre mantraḥ keṣāṃ na sidhyatipratimāsu śilābuddhi kurvāṇo narakaṃ vrajetna kadācidbhavet siddhirmantrairvā devatārcanaiḥteṣāṃ hi sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pātakaṃ bhavati priyeguruvīśeṣataḥ pūjyo dharmādharmapradarśakaḥśive ruṣṭe gurustrātā gurau ruṣṭe na kaścanaahitācaraṇāddevi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥkrimikīṭapataṅgatvaṃ prātnuvanti na saṃśayaḥgurumantraparityāgādrauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetnijaprāṇān parityajya gurukāryaṃ samācarettena santāḍito vāpi prasādamiti saṃsmarettaccheṣamiti sañcintya cānubhūyāt kuleśvaritīrthayātrāṃ na kuryācca na snāyādātmaśuddhayena kuryād gurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ śiṣyo bhūtvā kathañcanavilokya dūrato gacchennāsīta saha taiḥ kvacitsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ sā pūjā niṣphalā bhavettadājñayā tu karttavyamājñārūpo guruḥ smṛtaḥgurvājñayā tu gṛhṇīyāttanniṣiddhaṃ vivarjayetyadi brūyāt sa samayāccyuta eva na saṃśayaḥātmavat sarvabhūtebhyo hitaṃ kuryāt kuleśvariśuśrūṣayā dhiyā devi śiṣyaḥ santoṣayed gurumśuśrūṣaṇaparo yastu gurudevamahātmanām

sanskrit: sadbhaktisahitā cet sā sarvakāmaphalapradāsidhyanti sarvakāryāṇi guruśuśrūṣayā priyegurudevārcako yastu tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyatealpe mahati vā tulyaṃ puṇyamāḍhyadaridrayoḥśiṣyo na phalamāpnoti bhaktireva hi kāraṇamavaśyaṃ yadi vāñchā syādanubhūyāttadājñayālobhānmohāt sa pacyeta narake ca trisaptakesa tiryag yonimāpannaḥ kravyādairbhakṣyate priyepatitasya kṣullakasya prāyaścittaṃ na vidyategurudrohamidaṃ prāhuryaḥ karoti sa pātakīanivedya tu yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved brahmaghātakaḥgurubhiḥ sa bahiṣkāryo daṇḍyo vadhyaḥ sa ghātakaiḥvimṛtyugurunindāyāṃ gurvaniṣṭānmahāpadaḥmṛtyuhastagato vāpi nāparādhakaro guroḥgurornāma smaret paścāt śravaṇe sā pratikriyāna nindedasya samayān vedaśāstrāgamādikāngurvājñākaraṇaṃ kṛtyaṃ śuśrūṣā bhajanaṃ guroḥtāmbūlaṃ kajjalaṃ veśamutsṛjya praviśecchanaiḥdṛṣṭvā gurornamaskuryānnātmabhogāya kāmayetmūtraṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ kṣauraṃ śayanaṃ strīniṣevanamkeśamocanamuṣṇīṣaṃ kañcukaṃ nagnatāṃ tathāaṅgabhaṅgāṅgavādyādikarāsphālanadhūnanamnā caredācarenmohāddevatāśāpamāpnuyātmukhāvalokī seveta taduktañca samācaretśirasā yadgururbrūyāttat kāryamaviśaṅkayā

sanskrit: nirgataṃ yadgurorvaktrāt sarvaṃ śāstraṃ taducyatebahubhṛtyaparairbhṛtyaiḥ sahito'pyatibhaktimāngurvājñāmeva kurvīta tadagatenāntarātmanāsarvadā sevayet nityaṃ śiṣyaḥ bhrīgurusannidhaudevi bhūmyāsane tiṣṭhed gurukāryaṃ samācaretgurupārśvagato namraḥ prasannavadano bhavetācarettasya sarvasya doṣaḥ koṭiguṇo bhavetahitaṃ vā hitaṃ vāpi rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajettat pāpaṃ samavāpnoti gurvagre'nṛtabhāṣaṇātśrīguruṃ na tyajet kvāpi tadādiṣṭo vrajet priyena gacchedagratastasya na tiṣṭhedutthite gurauna teṣu kuryāt svacchāyāṃ na svaped gurusannidhauanādiṣṭo na kurvīta na cāvandanapūrvakamvinā gurvājñayā śiṣyau viśvasennānyaśāsanātbhaktyā praṇamya cottiṣṭhet kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ priyeekāsane nopaviśed guruṇā tatsamaiḥ sahadeśyāsanaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmitareṣāṃ samāsanamdaṇḍapraṇāmaṃ kṛtvaikaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇamācaretpraguroḥ sannidhau śiṣyaḥ svaguruṃ manasā nametna nameddevabuddhyā tu pratimāṃ lauhamṛṇmayīmpūjyānāmañjalistadvadanyeṣāṃ vākyavandanamvidyādhikān svadharmasthān praṇamet kulanāyikevikarmāṇaṃ kṛtaghnañcānāśramiṇañca no nametamedhyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ śūkaro jāyate mṛtaḥkrośāmātrasthitaḥ śiṣyo guruṃ pratidinaṃ namet

sanskrit: ekayojanamāramya yojanadvādaśāvadhidūradeśasthitaḥ śiṣyo bhaktyā tatsannidhiṃ gataḥatidūragataḥ śiṣyo yadicchā syāttadā vrajetphalapuṣpāmbarādīni yathāśaktyā samarpayetguruśaktiśca tatputro jyeṣṭhabhrātā guruḥ smṛtaḥgurukalpasya kurvīta praṇāmaṃ svaraguroryathāgurujyeṣṭhasuto devi iti jyeṣṭhacatuṣṭayamguruśca kulavṛkṣaśca vandanīyau vidhānataḥabhyutthānapraṇāmādyairavyakto doṣabhāgbahiḥabhyutthānapraṇāmādyairddoṣabhāk sa bhavettadāsa mahāpaśurityukto devatāśāpamāpnuyātguruvat sa tu mantavyo jyeṣṭhairvandyo na ca priyesamāsena kuleśāni kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasipādukākathanaṃ nāma dvādaśollāsaḥvaktumarhasi deveśa lakṣaṇaṃ guruśiṣyayoḥtasya śravaṇamātreṇa gurubhāvaḥ prajāyateparaśiṣyañca pāṣaṇḍaṃ ṣaṇḍaṃ paṇḍitamāninampaṅgumandhañca badhiraṃ malinaṃ vyādhipīḍitamduvīkārāṅgaceṣṭādigatibhāṣaṇavīkṣaṇamantarbhaktikaraṃ kṣudraṃ bāhyabhaktivivajītamdhanastrīśuddhirahitaṃ niṣedhavidhivajītammārjārabakavṛttiñca randhrānveṣaṇatatparamviśvāsaghātakaṃ svāmidrohiṇaṃ pāpakāriṇamātatāyinamāditsu kopitaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇamasatyaṃ niṣṭhurāsaktaṃ grāmyādibahubhāṣiṇam

sanskrit: vṛthākṣepakaraṃ mūrkhaṃ capalaṃ vāgviḍambakamvāgbrahmavādinaṃ vidyā cauramātmapraśaṃsakamvācālaṃ durjanasakhaṃ sarvalokavigahītamsvakleśavādinaṃ svāmidrohiṇaṃ svātmavañcakamakāraṇadveṣahāsakleśakrodhādikāriṇamkāmukañcātinirlajjaṃ mithyāduśceṣṭasūcakamīrṣyāpāruṣyapaiśunyakārpaṇyakrodhamānasamaprabuddhamatiṃ mandaṃ mūḍhaṃ cintākulaṃ viṭambahvāśinaṃ kapaṭinaṃ bhrāmakaṃ kuṭilaṃ priyemātāpitṛguruprājñasadvacohāsyakārakamityādidurguṇopetaṃ guruḥ śiṣyaṃ vivarjayetsamādhi sādhanopetaṃ guṇaśīlasamanvitamdṛḍhavrataṃ sadācāraṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitamvimṛśyakāriṇaṃ vīraṃ manodāridryavajītamkṛtajñaṃ pāpabhītañca sādhusajjanasammatamviśvāsavinayopetaṃ dhanadehādyavañcakamanukūlaṃ kriyāyuktamapramattaṃ vicakṣaṇamsakṛduktagṛhātārthaṃ caturaṃ buddhivistaramjitendriyaṃ susantuṣṭaṃ dhīmantaṃ brahmacāriṇamgurudhyānastutikathādevārcāvandanotsukamnityaṃ gurusamīpasthaṃ gurusantoṣakārakamgurvājñāpālakaṃ devi gurukīttīprakāśakamcittānuvattīnaṃ preṣyakāriṇaṃ kulanāyikenirapekṣaṃ gurudravye tatprasādābhikāṅkṣiṇamkulārcanādinirataṃ kuladravyājugupsakam

sanskrit: ityādilakṣaṇopetaṃ guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parigrahetsarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ sarvāvayavaśobhitaḥlokasammohanakaro devavat priyadarśanaḥiṅgitākāravit prājña ūhāpohavidujjvalaḥājñāsiddhistrikālajño nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥsvādhīnendriyasañcāraṣaḍvargavijayakṣamāḥśivaviṣṇusamaḥ sādhurmandadarśanadūṣakaḥsadbhaktavatsalo dhīraḥ kṛpāluḥ smitapūrṇavāksveṣṭadevagurujyeṣṭha vanitāpūjanotsukaḥrāgadveṣabhayakleśadambhāhaṅkāravajītaḥyadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭo guṇadoṣavibhedakaḥsarvāhambhāvasaṃyukto nirdvandvo niyatavrataḥvittavidyādibhirmantrayantratantrādyavikrayīityādilakṣaṇopetaḥ śrīguruḥ kathitaḥ priyevyomākāro hyajo'nantaḥ sa kathaṃ pūjyate priyebhaktyā sampūjito devi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayacchatitasmāt śrīgururūpeṇa śiṣyān rakṣati dhāmīkānsacchiṣyānugrahārthāya gūḍhaṃ paryaṭati kṣitauśivaḥ kṛpānidhirloke saṃsārīva hi ceṣṭateantardhāya ca vartteyaṃ gururūpo mahītaleacaturvadano brahmā śrīguruḥ kathitaṃ priyeśivavad dṛśyate loke bhavāni puṇyakarmaṇāmandabhāgyā na paśyanti hyandhāḥ sūryamivoditamśiva eva gururno cedbhukti mukti dadāti kaḥubhayorantaraṃ nāsti yaḥ karoti sa pātakī

sanskrit: chittvā paraṃ padaṃ devi nayatyenamato guruḥācāryarūpamāsthāya dīkṣayā mokṣayet paśūntathā devaśca mantraśca guruścaikārtha ucyatedevamantragurūṇāñca pūjayā sadṛśaṃ phalamgururūpaṃ samādāya bhavapāśānnikṛntayeavicchinnaḥ sadā hṛṣṭahṛdayo gururucyatejyotivarṇāśramī yogī sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo jānāti vidhānena sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyevināyāsaṃ sthiro vāyuryasya syāt sa guruḥ priyetattattvaṃ viditaṃ yena sa guruḥ kulanāyikevedhañca ṣaḍvidhaṃ devi sa hi vedhakaro guruḥśodhayed yaḥ ṣaḍadhvānaṃ sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo vetti pañcakaṃ devi sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo vā samyagvijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyecatuṣṭayaṃ vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo vetti parameśāni sa gururnāparaḥ priyetrividhaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥyo jānāti varārohe sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyetritayaṃ yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyetattvato yo vijānāti sa guruḥ kathitaḥ priyeyo viśodhayituṃ śaktaḥ sa guruḥ paramo mataḥyo jānāti mahādevi sa guruḥ paramo mataḥmūlabandhañca yo vetti sa guruḥ paramo mataḥyo vijānāti tattvena sa guruḥ paramo mataḥ

sanskrit: cāruyantravidhānañca yo vetti sa guruḥ priyeśirāsthiromasaṃkhyādi sa gururnāparaḥ priyeyamādyaṣṭāṅgayogajñaḥ sa guruḥ paramo mataḥkulaṃ śīlaṃ tathā jātiraṣṭau pāśāḥ prakīttītāḥtasmāt pāśaharo yastu sa guruḥ paramo mataḥyantramantrasvarūpañca yo vetti sa guruḥ priyecatuvīdhāṃ mano'vasthāṃ yo vetti sa guruḥ priyejīvācāraphalaṃ vetti sa gururnāparaḥ priyeavāptatattvasambhāraḥ sa gururnāparaḥ priyemanyate muktamātmānaṃ sa gururnāparaḥ priyesevyāste guravaḥ śiṣyairanye tyājyāḥ pratārakāḥvratopavāsaniyamainīyantā sa gururmataḥdurlabhaṃ taṃ vijānīyād guruṃ saṃsāratārakamkriyāyāsādirahitaṃ sa gururddevadurlabhaḥjñānopadeśaṃ kurute sa gururddevadurlabhaḥyo dadyāt sa gururjñānamabhyāsādivivajītamtathopadeśamātreṇa jñānado durlabho guruḥdurlabho'yaṃ gururdevi sūryavat sarvadīpakaḥdurlabho'yaṃ gururddevi paratattvārthapāragaḥdurlabho'yaṃ gururddevi lokeṣvātmaprakāśakaḥnigamāgamaśāstroktamantrajño durlabho bhuvidurlabho'yaṃ gururddevi śiṣyaduḥkhāpahārakaḥsarvasaṅkalpahīno yaḥ sa gururddevi durlabhaḥguruṃ tameva vṛṇuyānnāparaṃ matimānnaraḥyasyālokanamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: sā śaṅkā bhakṣitā yena sa gururddevidurlabhaḥtathā pāpaṃ vilīyate sadācārya samīpataḥtathā gurukaṭākṣastu śiṣyapāpaṃ dahet kṣaṇāttathaiva gurukāruṇyāt pāparāśiḥ palāyatesadgurorddarśanāddevi tathā'jñānaṃ vinaśyatisarvopāyavidhānajñastattvajñānī guruḥ sa himantrāgamādivijñānaṃ tattvahīnasya niṣphalamātmano'nugraho nāsti parasyānugrahaḥ kathamyo na jānāti cānyasya kathaṃ mokṣaṃ dadātyasautasmāttattvavideveha mukto mocaka eva catattvahīnāt kuto'dhyātmatattvajñānaparigrahaḥpaśubhiścopadiṣṭā ye devi te paśavaḥ smṛtāḥmuktastu mocayed baddhaṃ na mukto mocakaḥ kathamśilāṃ santārayennauhī kiṃ śilā tārayecchilāmihāmutra phalaṃ kiñcit sa naro nāpnuyāt priyevedaśāstreṣu śataśo gururekaḥ kulānvayeśikṣako bodhakaścaiva ṣaḍete guruvaḥ smṛtāḥpūjanīyā maheśāni bahutve'pi na saṃśayaḥlabdhvā jñānapradaṃ devi na gurvantaramāśrayetgurvantarantu gatvā sa naitaddoṣeṇa lipyatejñānalubdhastathā śiṣyaḥ gurogurvantaraṃ vrajetsamāsena kuleśāni kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasiguruśiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ nāma trayodaśollāsaḥupadeśakramaṃ dīkṣābhedāṃśca vada me prabhotasya śravaṇamātreṇa cittaśuddhiḥ prajāyate

sanskrit: sā ca na syādvinācāryamityācāryaparamparāantareṇopadeṣṭāraṃ mantrāḥ syunīṣphalā yataḥguruṃ mantrāgamābhijñaṃ samayācārapālakamkiñcitkālaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ svaśiṣyāya samarpayetdehānte śāśvatī muktiriti śaṅkarabhāṣitamsampradāyamavicchinnaṃ sadā kuryāt guruḥ priyepaścādupadiśenmantramanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetdadatā gṛhṇatā devi kulaśāpo bhaviṣyatiupadeśaṃ dadad gṛhṇan prāpnuyātāṃ piśācatāmbhuñjāte tāvubhau ghorānnarakānekaviṃśatimvinaśyati ca tanmantraṃ saikate śālibījavattasmāt parīkṣya karttavyamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetsannidhāyātmanaḥ śiṣyaṃ vadenmantraṃ na cānyathātajjñānaṃ tattuśāstrārthaṃ tadvidadhyādakhaṇḍitamtat prayātyapavitratvaṃ gokṣīraṃ śvaghṛtādivadevatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtañca niṣphalaṃ bhavetsaṃvatsaraṃ tadarddhaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā prayatnataḥprāṇadravyapraṇāmādyairādeśaiśca svayaṃ samaiḥpakṣapātairudāsīnairanekaiśca muhurmuhuḥguruḥ kṛpāṃ karotīti mudā sañcintayet sadāvandane paricaryāyāmāhvāne preṣaṇe priyeyeṣāṃ syuste'tra yogyāśca dīkṣāsaṃskārakarmaṇiānandādyairjapastotradhyānahomārcanādiṣuvedhakatvaṃ parijñāya śiṣyo bhūyānna cānyathāadhamā madhyamāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śiṣyā devi prakīttītāḥ

sanskrit: pādodakapradānādyaiḥ kuryāt pāpavimocanamvaiśyo yogyastribhirvarṣaiścatubhiḥ śūdra eva canādhikāraḥ svato nāryā bhāryāyā bhartturājñayātathaivādīkṣitaścāpi nādhikārī kuleśvaridīkṣitastoṣayeddevi yathāvibhavavistaramdīkṣābhedādikaṃ devi kimbhūyaḥ śrotumicchasiguruśiṣyaparīkṣākathanaṃ nāma caturdaśollāsaḥsthānāhārādibhedañca vada me parameśvaratasya śravaṇamātreṇa mantratattvaṃ prakāśatetasmājjapena dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sādhayetapramādād bhavet siddhiḥ pramādādaśubhaṃ phalamjapadhyānamayaṃ yogaṃ tasmāddevi samācaretjñānājñānakṛtāḥ sarvaṃ praṇaśyanti japāt priyepañcāṅgopāsanenaiva mantrajāpī vrajet sukhamhomo brāhmaṇabhuktiśca puraścaraṇamucyatekuryād dvitricatuḥpañca-saṃkhyāṃ vā sādhakaḥ priyetaccedaṅgaṃ vihīyeta mantrī neṣṭamavāpnuyātsubhojiteṣu vipreṣu sarvaṃ hi saphalaṃ bhavetsarvamantrāśca sidhyanti tvatprasādāt kuleśvarimantraprabhāvādbhaktyā ca mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatepūrvajanmakṛtābhyāsānmantro vā śīghrasiddhidaḥnyāyalabdhaśca yo mantraḥ sa ca siddho na saṃśayaḥanulomavilomena mantrasiddhiḥ prajāyatekramotkramātsahasrantu tasya siddho bhavenmanuḥjaṣitāḥ syurna sandeho yataḥ sarvaṃ tadudbhavam

sanskrit: mantraṃ gurukṛpāprāptamekaṃ syāt sarvasiddhidampatre sthitaṃ vā cādhyāpya tajjapaḥ syādanarthakṛtbrahmahatyāsamaṃ teṣāṃ pātakaṃ vyādhiduḥkhadamtīrthapradeśāḥ sindhūnāṃ saṅgamaḥ pāvanaṃ vanamdevatāyatanaṃ kūlaṃ samudrasya nijaṃ gṛhamathavā nivasettatra yatra cittaṃ prasīdatigoviprakulavṛkṣāṇāṃ sannidhau śasyate japaḥkoṭirdevālaye puṇyamanantaṃ śivasannidhauekāntapāvane nindārahite bhaktisaṃyuterājabhaktajanasthāne nivasettāpasāśrayecaranti yena mārgeṇa na vasettatra mantravitnadītaḍāgakūpeṣu bhūcchidrādiṣu no vasettatphalaṃ gṛhyate tena tasyāyāsaḥ phalaṃ bhavetvarjayedāsanaṃ dhīmān dāridryavyādhiduḥkhadamkalpayedāsanaṃ dhīmān saubhāgyajñānavṛddhidamjapārccanādikaṃ kuryādanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavetmuñcet piṅgalayā vāyumantaḥsthaṃ recako bhavetśanakairiḍayā baddhvā pūrakaṃ parikīttītamśoṣayedvāyubījena dehaśoṣaṇamīritamdahet dahanabījena dehadāhanamīritamāpādamastakaṃ devi plāvayet plāvanaṃ bhavetagarbhād garbhasaṃyuktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ śatādhikaḥprāṇāyāmasya tasyaite kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmtat sarvaṃ nirddahecchīghraṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ śivetathendriyāṇāṃ dahyante doṣāḥ prāṇasya saṃyamāt

sanskrit: īpsitaṃ labhate yena pūjāhomādikaṃ vināsthito mṛdvāsane dhyāyed guruvandanapūrvakamśrīprāsādaparābījaṃ ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyutamsaccandrabimbasañjātasudhāplāvitavigrahamsarvāriṣṭaṃ vilīyeta śubhaśrīpuṣṭikārakamtaruṇollāsasahito maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet priyegrahāpasmāravetālabhūtonmādādijaṃ bhayamjīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ pūjitaḥ sarvamānavaḥcinmayo jāyate sākṣānnātra kāryā vicāraṇātattatsthāneṣu deveśi pūrvavaccintayan japettatkṣaṇācchāntimāyānti rogāḥ sarve na saṃśayaḥyatra bījaṃ smarettatra tatphalaṃ bhavati dhruvamsarvarogapraharaṇaṃ vidyārogyapradaṃ priyesāttvikadhyānajaṃ devi phalametadudīritamvidhinānena deveśi saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavetbījaṃ sañcintayed yastu sa bhavedajarāmaraḥṣaḍādhārasthadevībhiḥ pūjyate kulanāyikeparāprāsādabījantu taruṇāruṇasannibhampañcaviśatibhiḥ sparśākṣaraiḥ saṃvītamambikeātmānañca smareddevi niścalenāntarātmanāaṣṭottarasahasrantu maṇḍalaṃ prajapet sudhīḥvidyādharānmunīn yakṣān nāgānapsarasaḥ striyaḥvaśyān karotyasandehaṃ kiṃ punarmānavādikānyasya mūdhnī smaran japyāt sa vaśyo jāyate haṭhātvaśyakarmāṇi sarvāṇi vidhinānena kārayet

sanskrit: asmāt parataraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥmūlamantraṃ likhenmadhye sādhyanāmasamanvitamkeśareṣu svarānaṣṭau vargān patreṣu pārvatipañcavarṇarajobhiśca śubhaṃ dṛṣṭimanoharamekatriṣaḍvasucatuḥkalasān sthāpayet priyeathavāṣṭādaśeśāni sapta vā daśa vā priyeasthiraktaśirātantumṛṇmāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ jalammantraprāṇasamāyuktāṃ yajet kalasadevatāmvidikṣu guruvighneśadurgākṣetrapatīn priyeabhiṣiñcet priyaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarvapāpapraśāntayerājābhiṣikto labhate catuḥsāgaragāṃ mahīmvandhyābhiṣiktā labhate putraṃ sarvaguṇānvitamtrilauhe vāpi bhūrje vā likhitvā yantramuttamamāyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vidyālābhaṃ yaśo jayamkhaḍgavaśyaṃ vayaḥstambhaṃ yakṣiṇyañjanapādukāmsañjīvayogaguṭikāpramukhākhilasiddhayaḥṣaṭ karmāṇi prayuñjīta nānyathā bhavati priyejuhuyāt pūrvavanmantrī devatādhyānatatparaḥnānāduṣṭamṛgān devi stambhayennātra saṃśayaḥasmāt parataraṃ dhyānaṃ nāsti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥduṣṭamāraṇakarmāṇi vidhinānena sādhayetṣaṭ karmāṇi prayuñjīta nānyathā vīravanditepalāśodumbarāśvatthaplakṣāpāmārgasatvacaiḥsitairanyaiḥ śubhairdrravyaiḥ samitpatraphalāntaraḥmadhuratrayasaṃyuktairmantravit kulanāyike

sanskrit: jñātvā devi sahasrantu juhuyādatha pañca vātattatkarmodite kuṇḍe saṃskṛte havyavāhanevidhivajjuhuyāddevi tadgatenāntarātmanāsarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ tatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥkadambāśokavakulapunnāgāmramadhūkajaiḥmālatīmallikājātibandhūkāruṇapaṅkajaiḥsanārikelakadalīdrākṣekṣupṛthukairapiraktairanyaiḥ śubhadravyaiḥ samidhṛtaphalodbhavaiḥmahīpatīṃśca puruṣān kāntā yauvanagavītāḥdevānapi kuleśāni vaśayennātra saṃśayaḥvidhinānena deveśi saubhāgyamuttamaṃ labhetanena mantrarājena nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacitkulārṇavārthatattvajño jīvanmuktaḥ kuleśvariparāprāsādamantrajño mukta eva na saṃśayaḥjñeyā bhairavadevyaśca ūrdhvāmnāyasya pārvatiasthikaṇṭakavṛkṣādyairdravyairaśubhasādhanaiḥgṛhadhūmacitāṅgāratrikaṭvamlacitāñjanaiḥsādhyapādarajobhiśca citābhasmasamanvitaiḥsamyakpratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ kuṇḍasyopari lambayetmalīmasena manasā cogradṛṣṭiramarṣaṇaḥtaddravyairjuhuyāddevi vidhivanmantravittamaḥśāntike sāttvikaṃ devi śvetavarṇaṃ vicintayettāmasaṃ krūrakāryeṣu kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vicintayetyo'nyathā kurute mohāt sa bhaveddevatāpaśuḥkṛtvā karmāṇi kurvīta nānyathā vīravandite

sanskrit: parāprāsādabījaṃ tat kalpāntāgnisamaprabhamsvayaṃ kālānalasamaḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṅkaraḥyauvanollāsasahitaḥ parāprāsādasaṃjñakamaniṣṭakāriṇaḥ sattvān kalahāyāsakāriṇaḥbhūtopagrahavetālān piśācān yakṣarākṣasānkṣaṇena nāśamāyānti śalabhā iva pāvakedhyānenānena deveśi kālādīnapi nāśayetsamāsena kuleśāni ki bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasikāmyakarmakathanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśollāsaḥtattvaṃ kulapadārthānāṃ vada me parameśvaratasya śravaṇamātreṇa kulajñānaṃ prakāśatevidyāvatārasaṃsiddhyai svīkṛtānekavigrahasarvājñānatamobhedabhānave caitanyāya caparatreha ca bhaktānāṃ bhavyānāṃ bhāvadāyinesadā saccittarūpeṇa vidhehi tava dāsatāmandhakāranirodhatvāt gururityabhidhīyateukāro viṣṇurityuktastritayātmā guruḥ paraḥukāraḥ śivatādātmyaṃ gururityabhidhīyaterudrādidevarūpatvād gururityabhidhīyateācinotīha śāstrārthānācāryastena kathyateyamādiyogasiddhatvādācārya iti kathyatedhyānaikaniṣṭhācittatvādārādhya iti kathyatekaruṇāmayamūttītvāddeśikaḥ kathitaḥ priyemithyājñānavihīnatvāt svāmīti kathitaḥ priyeśvādiprāṇiṣu sādṛśyād ramyatvācca maheśvaraḥ

sanskrit: sthagitājñānacihnatvāt śrīnāthaḥ kathitaḥ priyevaśīkṛtajagajjīvāddeva ityabhidhīyaterakṣaṇāt kamanīyatvāt bhaṭṭāraka itīritaḥbhuktimuktipradānācca prabhurityabhidhīyategīrvāṇagaṇapūjyatvād yogīti kathitaḥ priyemitha ātmanibandhatvāt saṃyamītyabhidhīyatesvīkārāt śubhakāryāṇāṃ tapasvītyabhidhīyatetattvamasyarthasiddhatvāt avadhūto'bhidhīyaterajastamovidūratvādvīra ityabhidhīyateyena mokṣa iti jñānaṃ kaulikaḥ so'bhidhīyatekulākulānusandhānānnipuṇāḥ kaulikāḥ priyekaraṇagrāmaniyamāt sādhakaḥ so'bhidhīyatetaratyakhiladuḥkhāni tasmādbhakta itīritaḥgurubhyaḥ śikṣate yogaṃ śiṣya ityabhidhīyatenirlīnopādhivibhavād yoginītyabhidhīyatetīvramuktipradānācca śaktirityabhidhīyatepāduketi samākhyātā mama tattvaṃ tava priyeparadevaprakāśācca japa ityabhidhīyatestotṛsantāraṇāddevi stotramityabhidhīyatesvāntenābhīṣṭadevasya cintanaṃ dhyānamucyatenaranārīsvarūpācca caraṇaṃ kathitaṃ priyedarśanānāṃ pramāṇatvādveda ityabhidhīyatenavabhaktyādijananāt purāṇa iti kathyatetāraṇāt sarvapāpebhyaḥ śāstramityabhidhīyatetimirotpāṭanāddevi smṛtirityabhidhīyate

sanskrit: haraṇāt sarvaduḥkhānāṃ itihāsa iti smṛtaḥmahātmatattvakathanādāgamaḥ kathitaḥ priyeparādiśaktisānnidhyācchākta ityabhidhīyateaśeṣakulasambandhāt kaula ityabhidhīyateyatibhiścintyamānatvāt paramparyamitīritamyaśaḥ saubhāgyakaraṇāt sampradāya itīritaḥyajñādidharmahetutvādāmnāya iti kītītaḥśrutau yadanavicchinnācchrauta ityabhidhīyaterāgadveṣādiśamanādācāra iti kīrttyatedīkṣeti kathitā sadbhirbhavabandhavimocanātkampānandādijananādabhiṣeka iti smṛtaḥśaktipātanimittādapyupadeśa iti smṛtaḥtrāyate sarvabhayatastasmānmantra itīritaḥtāpatrayādiśamanāddevatā parikīttītāsarvarakṣākarāddevi nyāsa ityabhidhīyatetasmānmudrā iti khyātā daśītavyāḥ kuleśvarimātṛkātmatayā lābhakaraṇādakṣamālikālalitatvācca deveśi maṇḍalaṃ parikīttītamśamitāpārapāpācca kalaśaḥ parikīttītaḥtrāyate satatañcaiva tasmād yantramitīritamnavasiddhipradānācca āsanaṃ kathitaṃ priyeaṣṭaduḥkhādivirahān madyamityabhidhīyatemadbhāvajananāddevi madyamityabhidhīyatesurākārapradānatvāt sureti parikīttītātattvaprakāśahetutvādamṛtaṃ kathitaṃ priye
